units.source_text: 她们的被褥，盖的被子和铺的褥子没有什么区别。

en.t: Their bedding was such that there was hardly any difference between the quilts they slept under and the mattresses they slept on.

units.source_text: 就是说，盖的被子硬邦邦的，同铺的褥子一样。

en.t: In other words, the quilts were stiff and hard, just like the mattresses.

units.source_text: 阿泷从壁橱里把脏被褥拽了出来，冷不防地说：

en.t: Otaki dragged the dirty bedding out of the closet and suddenly said:
